ext_desc.message: Download videos from any page: multi-threaded, HLS/DASH, MSE capture, A/V merging. No P2P, no telemetry, fully local.

popup_badge_bili_title.message: Direct MP4 URL from the Bilibili API — download without merging

popup_badge_mse_title.message: Captured from the MSE data stream — raw segments, independent of playback speed

popup_blob_tip.message: Blob/MSE video cannot be downloaded directly — use recording mode

popup_download_audio_title.message: Note: this is an audio-only track (no picture)

popup_download_title.message: Normal download: multi-threaded segmented direct download

popup_empty_hint.message: Play the video on the page, then click the refresh button above

popup_err_no_capture.message: Missing capture ID — cannot export the MSE data

popup_err_no_capture_merge.message: Missing capture ID — cannot merge and download

popup_force_title.message: Force download: send the source page credentials to bypass hotlink protection

popup_merge_title_bili.message: Fetch the complete A/V streams from the Bilibili API and merge them into a single MP4 with sound and picture

popup_merge_title_mse.message: Merge & download: automatically pair the audio and video tracks into one complete MP4 (for sites that store them separately, e.g. Tencent or iQiyi)

popup_mse_download_title.message: Direct MSE download: capture the raw media segments, not limited by playback speed

popup_paste_placeholder.message: Paste a video or stream URL, press Enter

popup_play_disabled_title.message: Blob/MSE video cannot be previewed — download it directly

popup_protected_title.message: This site uses a proprietary encrypted stream (e.g. Tencent cmfv); a direct download will not play — use recording or MSE capture instead

popup_record_hint.message: Actual recording time = video length ÷ N

popup_record_title.message: Recording mode: capture the frames while the video plays

popup_quality_none.message: No selectable variants for this stream

popup_toast_merging.message: Merging the audio and video tracks… keep the video page open

popup_toast_no_preview.message: This video cannot be previewed — download or record it instead

popup_toast_record_started.message: Recording started — play the video on the page

popup_toast_record_started_speed.message: Recording started ($1x) — play the video on the page

popup_track_audio_title.message: Audio only, no picture. A 12-minute clip is about 11-29 MB while the video track is hundreds of MB — do not download this by mistake

popup_track_video_title.message: DASH video-only track: silence is expected (the site stores audio and video separately). Play it with VLC or merge it with the audio track

dl_bili_incomplete.message: Incomplete download: file was interrupted and discarded. Please retry

dl_done_audio_track.message: Download complete! This is an audio-only track (sound but no picture, which is normal). If double-clicking does nothing, play it with VLC / PotPlayer, or download the video-track entry instead

dl_done_video_track.message: Download complete! Note: this is a DASH video-only track (no sound, which is normal). If your player cannot open it, use VLC/PotPlayer, or download the audio track as well and merge

dl_err_aborted.message: The request timed out or was interrupted; try again. If it keeps failing, choose another entry or quality

dl_err_bili_direct_failed.message: Video download failed and every strategy failed. Likely cause: the Bilibili CDN refused access — try playing the video first, then download again

dl_err_bili_stream_failed.message: Video stream download failed and every strategy failed. Likely cause: the Bilibili CDN refused access — try playing the video first, then download again

dl_err_merge_encrypted.message: This video is protected by encryption (pssh/tenc), so the merged file cannot be played. Use "Record" or the platform's official offline download instead

dl_err_merge_no_output.message: Merge failed: no file was produced

dl_err_merger_missing.message: The merge module is not loaded (mp4-merger.js is missing); reload the extension and try again

dl_err_no_stream_url.message: No stream URL was obtained; refresh the page and try again

dl_manual_save_hint.message: Download complete. Click "Save cached parts" to save the file

dl_no_data_to_save.message: there is no data to save

dl_note_audio_track.message: Note: this is an audio-only track (sound, no picture). For video, go back to the list and pick the larger entry with the "video track" badge

dl_note_video_track.message: Starting the DASH video track (no sound). Missing audio is by site design, not corruption; download the audio track as well and merge, or use recording

dl_player_load_failed.message: Failed to load the video source (MSE/memory stream, expired URL, or hotlink protection). Go back to the original video page, refresh it, then choose "Download" or "Record".

dl_player_memory_stream.message: This is a memory-stream (MSE/blob) URL that the download page cannot play directly. Go back to the original video page, refresh it, then choose "Download" or "Record".

dl_player_not_ready_generic.message: The video source was not ready within 8 seconds (it may be blocked by hotlink protection or unsupported for direct playback). Go back to the list and pick another entry, or choose "Download".

dl_player_not_ready_memory.message: The video source was not ready within 8 seconds: this is a memory stream (MSE) or an expired blob URL that cannot be played on the download page. Go back to the original video page, refresh it, then choose "Download" or "Record".

dl_record_blackframe.message: Warning: the picture stays completely black — this video is protected by encryption (the browser forces a black video output) and cannot be bypassed. The recorded file will contain audio only, so stopping the recording is recommended

dl_record_cors_warning.message: Warning: the video is blocked by cross-origin (CORS) restrictions, so frames cannot be captured. This site does not allow cross-origin access; recording would only produce a black screen. Use "MSE capture" to download instead

dl_record_done.message: Recording complete! The file "$1" was saved ($2)

dl_record_failed.message: Recording failed: $1. Make sure the video is playing, or use "MSE capture" to download

dl_record_hint.message: Records the decoded picture; use it for streams that cannot be downloaded directly. Keep the video playing on the source page.

dl_record_status_hint.message: Recording… keep the video playing on the source page. Note: recording is real-time capture, so the rate is about the video bitrate and is limited by playback speed; encrypted content always records as a black screen and cannot be exported legitimately — use the platform's official offline download instead

dl_record_warn_cors.message: Warning: the recording rate is low (<200KB/s). A cross-origin (CORS) restriction was detected, so frames cannot be captured and the recording may contain audio only. Use MSE capture to download instead

dl_record_warn_generic.message: Warning: the recording rate is low (<200KB/s). The video bitrate may simply be low, or the picture may be mostly static. If the recorded file will not play, use MSE capture instead

dl_record_warn_low_rate.message: Warning: the recording rate is extremely low (<50KB/s); the video is protected by encryption (the browser forces a black video output) and MSE interception yields only ciphertext, so nothing can be exported. Stopping the recording and using the platform's official offline download is recommended

dl_record_warn_paused.message: Warning: the recording rate is low (<200KB/s). The video does not seem to be playing; make sure it is playing on the source page

dl_setting_boost_enable.message: Enable adaptive connection scaling (accelerate automatically when there is enough bandwidth)

dl_setting_boost_hint.message: Monitors bandwidth usage and opens extra download connections to boost speed

dl_setting_cache_onexit.message: Clear the cache automatically when leaving the page

dl_setting_location_hint.message: The actual download folder is controlled by your Chrome/Edge browser settings

dl_setting_privacy_enable.message: Privacy mode (history keeps only the domain, not the full URL)

dl_setting_privacy_hint.message: When enabled, download history keeps only the source domain and never exposes the full video URL

dl_setting_savemode_auto.message: Save automatically (save as soon as the download finishes)

dl_setting_savemode_manual.message: Manual save (click the button when the download finishes)

dl_setting_threads_hint.message: More connections download faster (aria2 dynamic segmentation; extra connections open automatically when bandwidth allows)

dl_status_converting.message: Converting the container to MP4 (improves iPhone/mobile compatibility; unconverted TS often will not play on phones)…

dl_status_paused.message: Paused. Click "Resume" to continue the download

dl_status_preparing.message: Preparing the download (registering the task, requesting storage)…

dl_status_probing.message: Probing the video source (up to about 15 seconds if the server responds slowly)…

dl_warn_small_file.message: Warning: the file is only $1; it may be a preview clip or a video-only track (no audio). If it will not play after downloading, use "MSE capture" or "Record" instead

sw_capture_stale.message: The capture expired when the page reloaded; replay the video and click the newest entry

sw_diag_intercepted.message: (diagnostic: network reachable, request blocked by a browser security mechanism — try restarting the browser; if it still reproduces, send this log line to the developer)

sw_dl_stalled.message: Download stalled (no new data for 30s) — server stopped responding

sw_dns_private.message: This domain resolves to a private/reserved address; blocked by SSRF protection

sw_dns_timeout.message: DNS safety check timed out: local DNS did not respond for this domain (check your system DNS/proxy software and retry)

sw_manifest_connect_failed.message: Network error: cannot reach the manifest server ($1)$2

sw_manifest_timeout.message: Manifest request timed out (server not responding)

sw_preview_unsupported.message: This video type cannot be previewed

sw_proxy_timeout.message: Proxy request timed out ($1s) — server not responding

sw_recording_tab_lost.message: The source page was closed or navigated away; recording could not start

sw_rule_pool_exhausted.message: Rule ID pool exhausted; retry later

sw_seg_stalled.message: Segment download stalled (no new data for 30s) — server stopped responding

sw_session_unavailable_download.message: Browser session storage is unavailable; the download URL cannot be passed securely. Please retry or check your browser storage settings

sw_session_unavailable_params.message: Browser session storage is unavailable; the download parameters cannot be passed securely. Please retry or check your browser storage settings

sw_session_unavailable_play.message: Browser session storage is unavailable; the playback URL cannot be passed securely. Please retry

cs_merge_encrypted.message: This stream is encrypted (paid content); the MSE data itself is ciphertext, so the export will not play. Free content downloads normally

cs_merge_failed_detail.message: Audio/video merge failed. Fallback: download the video and audio tracks separately and merge them manually

cs_merge_no_audio.message: No matching audio track found, so merging is not possible. Download the video track (silent) or use recording instead

cs_merge_not_ready.message: The merger is not ready — refresh the page and try again

cs_merge_timeout.message: The audio/video merge request timed out — make sure the video has started playing, then try again

cs_mse_ad_cleared.message: Content switched (ad → main video). Ad data cleared — click the MSE download again

cs_mse_empty.message: The MSE capture is empty — play the video before downloading

cs_mse_not_found.message: No MSE capture data found — make sure the video has started playing

cs_mse_rate_limited.message: Too many MSE data requests — wait a few seconds and try again

cs_mse_timeout.message: The MSE data request timed out — make sure the video has started playing, then try again

cs_mse_truncated.message: This capture hit the size limit; the exported file leaves out the excess (the video may be incomplete)

cs_no_video_element.message: There is no video element on this page

cs_no_video_element_found.message: No video element was found on this page

cs_record_encrypted.message: This video is encrypted; recording would be black and there is no legitimate export path — use the platform's official offline download

cs_record_encrypted_detail.message: This video is encrypted: recording produces a black screen and MSE interception only yields encrypted data, so neither can be exported. Use the platform's official offline download feature

cs_record_limit.message: Recording reached the $1GB limit — stopped automatically and saved what was recorded so far

cs_record_no_data.message: Recording captured no data. The video may not be playing, or browser output protection is blocking it

de_block_font.message: Content is a font file (woff/woff2), not a video — blocked

de_block_html.message: Content is an HTML page (the link may be dead or require login) — blocked

de_block_image.message: Content is an image, not a video — blocked

de_block_json.message: Content is JSON data (usually hotlink protection or an error response) — blocked

de_block_pdf.message: Content is a PDF document, not a video — blocked

de_block_zip.message: Content is a ZIP archive, not a video — blocked

de_conn_timeout.message: Connection timed out; no data arrived

de_incomplete_download.message: Incomplete download: file was interrupted and discarded. Please retry

de_opfs_unavailable.message: OPFS is unavailable; cannot read the proxied segment

de_proxy_probe_timeout.message: Proxied probe request timed out ($1s) — the service worker did not respond

de_proxy_seg_timeout.message: Proxied segment request timed out ($1s) — the service worker did not respond

de_range_misalign.message: CDN returned a mismatched range (requested $1, got $2) — write refused

de_req_timeout.message: Request timed out ($1s) — the server did not respond

de_seg_no_data.message: Segment had no data / short read ($1/$2)

de_seg_proxy_timeout.message: Proxied segment request timed out (65s) — the service worker is busy or unresponsive; retrying automatically

de_seg_stall.message: Segment download stalled (no new data for $1s; the server dropped the response)

de_segments_failed.message: $1 segments failed repeatedly (CDN throttling or refusal). Aborted without producing a corrupt file — please retry later, or reduce the number of concurrent downloads

de_srv_no_range.message: The server does not support Range requests

de_sw_timeout.message: Service worker response timed out ($1s) — it may be asleep or busy, type=$2

de_url_invalid.message: Invalid URL: only the http/https protocol is supported, local addresses are blocked

sd_aes_key_failed.message: Failed to fetch the AES-128 key; please try recording mode

sd_dash_no_video.message: No video track in the DASH manifest

sd_dash_parse_failed.message: Failed to parse the DASH manifest

sd_manifest_cors.message: Failed to fetch the manifest: the server refused cross-origin access or did not respond. Please retry, or go back to the list and download another item/quality

sd_manifest_http.message: Failed to fetch the manifest: HTTP $1

sd_manifest_timeout.message: Manifest fetch timed out (15s) — the server is too slow or the network is restricted; please retry or pick another item/quality

sd_no_segments.message: No downloadable segments were found in the manifest

sd_seg_key_failed.message: Failed to fetch the segment key

sd_seg_timeout.message: Segment fetch timed out (30s) — the server is too slow or the connection was interrupted

sd_segments_failed.message: $1 segments failed repeatedly (of $2 total); aborted without producing a corrupt file. Try reducing the number of concurrent downloads

sd_url_invalid.message: Invalid URL: only the http/https protocol is supported, local addresses are blocked

nh_sw_timeout.message: Service worker response timed out ($1s) — it may be asleep or busy, type=$2
